name: queryParticipantOverview
shortDescription: Provides a detailed overview of a Stump participant, including assigned quadrants, categories, responsibilities, and deliverables.
description:
Overview

Fetches a complete overview of a User (Stump), including their assigned Quadrants, Categorys, Responsibilitys, and Deliverables.

Intended use

Called by the Quadrant and Participant Detail View UI or an AI agent to display a Stump's profile and workload. Parameter is stumpId (or ctx.user_id if Stump is calling).

Logic

  1. Determine targetStumpId: if ctx.role is 'stump', use ctx.user_id; otherwise, use params.stumpId and validate that params.stumpId corresponds to an existing User with the stump app role. If not found or not a Stump, return an error.
  2. Retrieve the User record for targetStumpId via ctx.data.get.
  3. Query QuadrantParticipant entities linked to targetStumpId using ctx.data.query.
  4. For each QuadrantParticipant, retrieve the associated Quadrant details using ctx.data.get.
  5. Query ParticipantCategory entities linked to targetStumpId using ctx.data.query.
  6. For each ParticipantCategory, retrieve the associated Category details using ctx.data.get.
  7. Query Responsibility entities where idOfUser is targetStumpId using ctx.data.query.
  8. Query Deliverable entities where idOfUser is targetStumpId using ctx.data.query.
  9. Combine all retrieved data into a single response object.
  10. Return the combined data.

Entities

  • User
  • QuadrantParticipant
  • Quadrant
  • ParticipantCategory
  • Category
  • Responsibility
  • Deliverable
